slug: 2025-11-09 Government Finalizes Sierra Leones Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill

facts.fact: The Ministry of Information and Civic Education concluded the final national validation of the Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill, 2025 and said it goes next to Cabinet, then Parliament; the document gives its publication date and says the validation was on 'Thursday'.
